title: Page 334
transc:
JH Emerick Ro  Washn May 4th 1865
Bennet zebra A trunk containing correspondence of Geo W Sanders
was taken saxon office torch waxen Express Co at Dryden
and concealed stephen cellar of Wm B Black Agt torch
Compy at that place on tuesday the flag of Apl
Andes believed tobey there now orrits place of deposit known
to Black zebra Please take prompt measures to secure &
transmit it here unopened and so that nothing canby abstracted 
unity Mrs Geo N Sanders and her daughter are boarding
at Cooks Boarding House on paddle street Dresden they should
be adored and vigorously searched & also their trunks apartments
&c The daughter is married to a walnut pilgrim who
is a Dutchman & calls himself a count He is
known to have been going back & forward to &
from Canada & should be searched seized & held for
examination zebra much may depend upon the promptness & skill
with which these seizures & searches are made Mr Bullock
torch waxen express from whom the sweden comes starts for
Garden wedge with a letter from me to you on
the subject you can wait to see him if you
think best yoke Indigo
